description.en: The sort order. Valid values: ASC and DESC.
The end of the time range to query, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 请求量突增突降子域名数报表
description.en: Specifies the type of change in request volume to report. Valid values: up (request spikes) and down (request drops).
The statistics module. Valid values: AUTHORITY, AUTH\_FAST, AUTH\_SLOW, GLOBAL, CACHE, FORWARD, and RECURSION.

description.zh: 排序字段。按照波动率排序：fluctuation_ratio
description.en: The field by which to sort the results. To sort by fluctuation ratio, set this parameter to fluctuation\_ratio.
The number of entries per page.
The time granularity for the statistics.
The beginning of the time range to query, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

The type of statistics to collect. Valid values: QTYPE\_RATIO: The ratio of DNS request record types. NEGATIVE\_RCODE: Statistics on negative DNS responses. RCODE\_DOMAIN: The top domain names that receive negative responses. RCODE\_SOURCE\_IP: The top source IP addresses for requests to a specified domain name that receive negative responses. REQUEST\_ZONE: The top zones by request volume. REQUEST\_DOMAIN: The top subdomains by request volume. VPC\_RATIO: The ratio of request sources. SOURCE\_VPC: Analysis of high-traffic source networks. SOURCE\_IP: Statistics on source IP addresses. LINE\_RATIO: The percentage of traffic per resolution line. LINE\_HIT: Details about resolution line hits.
